digest.component_or_area: LLM config schema and class-based model resolution
propositions: A new module model_classes.py must expose three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional non-recursive fallback array, with secrets forbidden at both slot and fallback-entry level.

The class resolver must map class name to a provider-qualified model string, inferring provider via infer_provider when omitted, and defaulting to claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, and claude-opus-4-8 for trivial, standard, and frontier respectively when unconfigured.

Environment variables REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL/PROVIDER/ENDPOINT (and same for STANDARD_ and TRIVIAL_) must override config-file slot fields independently, preserving CLI > env > file > default precedence per key.

load_class_slots() must serve as the named entry point that reads the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and returns fully resolved slots, proving parser reachability from real configuration.

Fallback entries must validate to slot-minus-fallback schema (model required, provider optional with infer_provider, endpoint optional, api_key forbidden, no nested fallback allowed), parsed and carried but not yet runtime-consumed.
Nine new env vars (REBAR_LLM_{FRONTIER,STANDARD,TRIVIAL}_{MODEL,PROVIDER,ENDPOINT}) must be documented as literals in docs/env-vars.md with regenerated output committed in this change.
